name: Magus Mnemonic Warrior
body:
Adaptive Feat (Ex)

At 5th level, spend 1 arcane pool point as a full-round action to gain any feat whose prerequisites are met for 8 hours. Gains a 2nd slot at 17th level. Replaces 5th- and 17th-level bonus feats.

Tactical Focus (Ex)

At 11th level, study a foe (standard action; Will negates DC 10 + 1/2 level + Int) to gain +1 insight on attacks, +2 on damage, and +2 to AC against that foe for rounds equal to 1/2 level. Replaces 11th-level bonus feat.

Mnemonic Arcana

Akashic Sight (blindsight 10 ft. + 10 ft./4 levels above 8th), Forgotten Fear (touch panics foe 1d4 rounds), Mnemonic Pain (touch inflicts staggered and -8 penalty for 1 hour), One Mind One Fight (teamwork feat swap), Prescience (bonus to saves and initiative), Quick Study (+2 skill check bonus), Tongues (speak/understand all languages as tongues), Traumatizing Touch (touch confuses 1d6 rounds).
